content: कुलीन {%a.%} [कुले जातः ख] .²1 Of high descent, of a good family, well-born; दिव्ययोषितमिवाकुलीनाम् <ls>K. 11</ls>; न वै सोम्यास्मत्कुलीनः <ls>Ch. Up. 6. 1. 1</ls>. .{@-नः@} A horse of good breed. .²2 A worshipper of Śakti according to the left-hand ritual. .²3 A Brāhmaṇa of the highest class in Bengal. .{@-नम्@} A disease of the nails, <ls>Bhāg. 7. 6. 12</ls>.
